description: Asks to remove one person from the workspace, named by their user id (list_members gives ids) or the email address they sign in with, as Remove in Settings › People does. An owner can remove anyone else; an admin can remove members but not an admin or an owner; the workspace's only owner is never removed, and nobody removes themselves this way. Nothing happens until you approve it in CodeGene: the answer gives a link to the request, which waits there for 15 minutes. Send the person that link; you cannot approve it. Then call get_approval with the requestId to learn how it ended. Once approved, they can no longer open the workspace or its projects, and any invitation of theirs still waiting stops working. They are not told.

member.description: The person: their user id from list_members, or the email address they sign in with.

reason.description: Why, in a sentence: kept in the workspace's activity.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.
